questions.prompt: What sound does a cow make?
questions.note: Cows moo to talk to each other and to their calves.

questions.prompt: Which animal has a long trunk?
questions.note: An elephant uses its trunk like a hand to pick things up.

questions.prompt: A baby cat is called a what?
questions.note: Kittens sleep for most of the day.

questions.prompt: How many legs does a dog have?
questions.note: Dogs walk on four legs.

questions.prompt: Which animal hops and says ribbit?
questions.note: Frogs can jump many times their own length.

questions.prompt: Fish live in water.
questions.note: Fish breathe underwater using gills.

questions.prompt: Which bird swims very well but cannot fly?
questions.note: Penguins use their wings like flippers.

questions.prompt: Which animal gives us wool?
questions.note: A sheep grows a thick woolly coat that is cut off once a year.

questions.prompt: Which animal is the tallest in the world?
questions.note: A giraffe can reach leaves very high in the trees.

questions.prompt: A spider has six legs.
questions.note: Spiders have eight legs. Insects have six.

questions.prompt: What colour do you get if you mix blue and yellow paint?
questions.note: Blue and yellow make the green of grass and leaves.

questions.prompt: What colour do you get if you mix red and yellow paint?
questions.note: Red and yellow make orange, just like the fruit.

questions.prompt: What colour is a ripe banana?
questions.note: Bananas start green and turn yellow as they ripen.

questions.prompt: How many sides does a triangle have?
questions.note: Tri means three.

questions.prompt: Which shape has four equal sides and four square corners?
questions.note: A square is a special kind of rectangle.

questions.prompt: A circle has corners.
questions.note: A circle is perfectly round, with no corners at all.

questions.prompt: What colour is the sky on a clear, sunny day?
questions.note: Sunlight is scattered by the air, and blue light scatters the most.

questions.prompt: How many colours are in a rainbow, as we usually count them?
questions.note: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet.

questions.prompt: Which solid shape is a ball?
questions.note: A sphere is round all the way around.

questions.prompt: What colour do you get if you mix red and white paint?
questions.note: The more white you add, the paler the pink.

questions.prompt: Which season comes after winter?
questions.note: In spring, flowers open and new leaves grow.

questions.prompt: What do bees make?
questions.note: A bee makes only a tiny bit of honey in its whole life.

questions.prompt: Carrots grow underground.
questions.note: The orange part of a carrot is a root.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a fruit?
questions.note: An apple grows on a tree and has seeds inside.

questions.prompt: What do hens lay?
questions.note: A good laying hen can lay nearly one egg a day.

questions.prompt: What do we call frozen water?
questions.note: Water turns to ice when it gets cold enough.

questions.prompt: The Sun comes up in the morning.
questions.note: We call this sunrise.

questions.prompt: A caterpillar can turn into what?
questions.note: The caterpillar rests in a cocoon or chrysalis while it changes.

questions.prompt: What colour are most leaves in summer?
questions.note: Leaves are green because of a substance called chlorophyll.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the planet we live on?
questions.note: Earth is the only planet we know that has living things.

questions.prompt: Who huffs and puffs in The Three Little Pigs?
questions.note: The wolf could not blow down the house made of bricks.

questions.prompt: How many bears does Goldilocks meet in the story?
questions.note: Daddy bear, Mummy bear and Baby bear.

questions.prompt: What did Cinderella lose at the ball?
questions.note: The prince used the slipper to find her.

questions.prompt: In the rhyme, what was Humpty Dumpty sitting on?
questions.note: Humpty is usually drawn as an egg.

questions.prompt: What does Jack get for his cow in Jack and the Beanstalk?
questions.note: The beans grew into a giant beanstalk overnight.

questions.prompt: Who does Little Red Riding Hood go to visit?
questions.note: She carries a basket of food for her.

questions.prompt: In the nursery rhyme, how many blind mice are there?
questions.note: They ran after the farmer's wife in the rhyme.

questions.prompt: What does the Gingerbread Man keep doing in the story?
questions.note: He tells everyone they cannot catch him.

questions.prompt: Who wrote The Tale of Peter Rabbit?
questions.note: Beatrix Potter also drew the pictures herself.

questions.prompt: What does the Ugly Duckling grow up to be?
questions.note: He was a beautiful swan all along.

questions.prompt: How many days are there in a week?
questions.note: Monday to Sunday.

questions.prompt: How many fingers and thumbs are on one hand?
questions.note: Two hands make ten.

questions.prompt: Which part of the body do we use to see?
questions.note: Eyes work with the brain to make pictures of the world.

questions.prompt: How many months are in a year?
questions.note: January is the first and December is the last.

questions.prompt: The Moon is made of cheese.
questions.note: The Moon is made of rock.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the star that gives us light in the day?
questions.note: The Sun is a star that looks big because it is close.

questions.prompt: Which meal do we eat in the morning?
questions.note: Break-fast means ending the night's fast.

questions.prompt: How many wheels does a bicycle have?
questions.note: Bi means two.

questions.prompt: What do we use to clean our teeth?
questions.note: Brush your teeth twice a day.

questions.prompt: At traffic lights, which colour means stop?
questions.note: Green means go.
